name: Beef Tallow
imageAlt: rendered pure traditional beef tallow block in a jar
description: Beef tallow is a highly stable animal lipid matrix composed of triglycerides rich in saturated and monounsaturated fatty acids. Renowned for its biochemical heat resistance, it provides a dense metabolic fuel source, CLA, and fat-soluble vitamins that reinforce cellular structures and metabolic homeostasis.
macroIntro: A pure, water-free hydrophobic lipid profile isolated from proteins and carbohydrates.
microIntro: A lipophilic matrix containing specialized fatty acids and antioxidants supporting metabolic health.

macroNutrients.name: Calories
macroNutrients.description: Maximal energy density serving as a sustained non-glycemic fuel reserve.

microNutrients.name: Stearic Acid
microNutrients.description: Unique saturated fatty acid neutral to hepatic LDL receptor expression.

microNutrients.name: Oleic Acid (Omega-9)
microNutrients.description: Monounsaturated acid preserving vascular endothelial flexibility.

microNutrients.name: Conjugated Linoleic Acid (CLA)
microNutrients.description: Ruminant isomer linked to lean tissue preservation and immune modulation.

microNutrients.name: Dietary Cholesterol
microNutrients.description: Sterol precursor for steroid hormones and Vitamin D synthesis.

healthBenefits: Thermal Stability: Massive smoke point (~210°C) prevents toxic aldehyde formation.
CLA Delivery: Modulates inflammation and supports metabolic lean tissue maintenance.
Lipophilic Transport: Improves bioavailability of vitamins A, D, E, K.
Membrane Reinforcement: Provides essential fatty acid matrix for lipid bilayers.
Non-Insulinogenic: Pure triglyceride stream promotes stable ketogenesis.
precautionsIntro: Considerations for caloric density and source quality:
precautions: Caloric Excess: High energy density necessitates portion control to prevent surplus.
Saturated Lipid Markers: Moderate consumption to manage potential shifts in LDL/ApoB levels.
Sourcing: Prioritize pasture-raised, grass-fed tallow to minimize accumulation of environmental lipophilic toxins.
